links.outcome: Expert-blinded ratings of ChatGPT vs expert clinician OCD exposure hierarchies
links.effect: Expert hierarchies rated significantly more appropriate, specific, variable, and useful than ChatGPT (ps < .05); safety/ethics not different (p = .24).
links.quote: However, expert human-generated hierarchies were still rated as significantly more appropriate, specific, variable, and useful, ps < .05, but not more or less safe and ethical than ChatGPT-generated hierarchies, p = .24.

unlisted_practices: Providing more detailed symptom information in prompts to improve LLM-generated exposure hierarchies

screen.reason: Evaluated the feasibility and quality of ChatGPT-4 generating exposure hierarchies for simulated OCD patient vignettes, comparing outputs to expert clinicians without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
